title: 婦嬰新說 / Fu ying xin shuo [New Treatise on Women and Infants]: Bodleian Sinica 1792 transcription dataset

titles.title: New Treatise on Women and Infants
titles.note: Not an official catalogue English title.

abstract.zh: 《婦嬰新說》（Fu ying xin shuo）由合信（Benjamin Hobson）著、管茂材同撰，為1858年上海仁濟醫館刊行的中文醫學著作，內容涉及女性身體、妊娠、分娩及嬰幼兒疾病，並附醫學圖說，可供十九世紀醫學史、醫學翻譯與圖像研究參考。本資料依牛津Bodleian Libraries所藏Sinica 1792，提供137面原文的JSON、TXT及TEI，保留原字、句讀與疑讀，逐頁連結來源，另附明示小註插入的閱讀檔。資料由AI輔助轉錄；新增9面仍屬初錄，未經專家審定。
abstract.en: Fu ying xin shuo (婦嬰新說), written by Benjamin Hobson with Guan mao cai and published by Ren ji yi guan in Shanghai in 1858, is a Chinese medical work concerning the female body, pregnancy, childbirth and childhood illnesses, accompanied by medical illustrations. It offers material for the study of nineteenth-century medicine, medical translation and visual culture. Based on Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford, Sinica 1792, this dataset supplies 137 source faces in JSON, TXT and TEI, preserving source characters, punctuation and uncertainties, with page-level source links and a separately labelled reading file showing note insertions. The transcription is AI-assisted; the nine newly added faces remain initial transcription and have not received expert review.

methods.zh:
依牛津 Bodleian Libraries 所藏 Sinica 1792 的影像逐面轉錄，保留原字、異體、原有圈點與疑讀，不另加現代標點或依文義改字。既有128面、1504個文字單元保留先前獨立 AI 讀稿比較及知悉初稿後對照來源的覆核狀態；新增9面、103個文字單元為 AI 輔助初錄，另對實際取得的局部細圖回看，沒有把137面視為全文獨立二校。

JSON、TXT 與 TEI 依同一固定文字匯出，逐字核對讀序與來源對應。小註另存與正文的關係；衍生閱讀檔以編輯標記顯示兩處新增小註的插入位置，不改動原文層。共保留51筆當前疑讀。格式檢查採 TEI P5 4.12.0 與 CFF 1.2.0 正式規格；這些檢查不代表文字準確率。尚未經人類全文校勘、專家審定或同儕審查。實際 AI 模型與完整用量資料未能確認。原圖、裁片、專用程式、提示與完整工作紀錄未隨資料公開，因此不宣稱可由公開包完整重跑影像辨讀流程。
methods.en:
The transcription follows the images of Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford, Sinica 1792, face by face, retaining source characters, variants, printed punctuation and uncertain readings without modernization or contextual correction. The existing 128 faces and 1504 text units retain their previous independent AI reading comparison and subsequent source review conducted with access to the draft. The nine added faces and 103 units are AI-assisted initial transcription, with limited checks against the detail images actually obtained. This does not constitute independent collation of all 137 faces.

JSON, TXT and TEI are generated from the same fixed transcription and checked for exact text order and source correspondence. Notes retain separate links to the body text; a reading derivative uses explicit editorial markers for the two newly positioned notes without changing the literal layer. There are 51 current uncertainty records. Formal checks use TEI P5 4.12.0 and CFF 1.2.0; these checks do not measure textual accuracy. Human full-text collation, expert review and peer review have not been performed. Exact AI model identity and complete usage data are unconfirmed. Source images, crops, specialized programs, prompts and full working records are not distributed, so the image-reading process cannot be fully reproduced from the public package.

notes.zh: 底本為牛津 Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford 所藏 Sinica 1792。館目記1858年上海仁濟醫館刊；當冊實際印次及掃描日期未知。方括號英題 New Treatise on Women and Infants 為編者意譯。資料涵蓋136個內文面及1個封面，提供 JSON、TXT、TEI、逐頁來源索引、疑讀與小註閱讀檔。歷史原文以 Public Domain Mark 1.0 標示，整理者不另加限制；具著作性的新增說明及書目資料採 CC BY 4.0。來源影像未納包，仍須遵守 Bodleian 個別原件條款及 CC BY-NC 4.0 影像條件；館藏連結不表示館方認可轉錄。
notes.en: Source: Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford, Sinica 1792. The catalogue records publication at Ren ji yi guan, Shanghai, in 1858; the actual impression and scan date of this copy are unknown. The bracketed English title, New Treatise on Women and Infants, is an editorial translation. The dataset covers 136 interior faces and one cover, with JSON, TXT, TEI, page-level source references, uncertainty records and a note-aware reading file. The historical text is marked with Public Domain Mark 1.0 and carries no additional restriction imposed by the editor. Copyrightable new documentation and metadata are licensed under CC BY 4.0. No source images are supplied; Bodleian item terms and CC BY-NC 4.0 image conditions remain applicable to the images. Source links do not imply institutional endorsement.
